title: Legacy of the Ancients
text: Legacy of the Ancients is a fantasy role-playing video game published by Electronic Arts in 1987.

title: Sarafina! (film)
text: Sarafina! is a 1992 South African film directed by Darrell Roodt and starring Leleti Khumalo, Whoopi Goldberg, Miriam Makeba, John Kani and Tertius Meintjies.

title: SMU Mustangs football under Mike Cavan
text: Mike Cavan was the coach of the Southern Methodist University's football team from 1997 to 2001. He compiled a 22–34–0 record, and was succeeded by Phil Bennett.
